purpose: Bounded engineering source-fidelity test inside the approved splat family; no Kyoto or full-route qualification

source.title: Knock Community Hall
source.author: scbenoit
source.capture_method: Publisher describes a Phantom 4 drone capture, 185 images, Metashape 2.3.0 COLMAP data, Brush 14000 iterations and SuperSplat cleanup.
source.location: Publisher identifies Knock Community Hall and links the Innisfil municipal Knock Community Centre page. Exact coordinates were not independently verified.
source.publication_date: Publisher page displays relative age 5mo ago; exact publication and capture dates remain unverified.
source.rights: Publisher page displays CC BY 4.0; independent official PlayCanvas asset sidecar explicitly identifies scbenoit, same source scene, CC-BY-4.0 and attribution requirement.
source.attribution: Knock Community Hall by scbenoit, https://superspl.at/scene/0ff2e6dc, licensed CC BY 4.0. Original SOG components repackaged unchanged in a ZIP container for local engineering comparison.

recommended_asset.packaging_method: Python standard-library zipfile ZIP_STORED, each original source byte retained unchanged; source and ZIP-entry SHA256 equality verified for all eight entries.

published_default_camera.extraction_method: BeautifulSoup extracts native viewer application/json script; Python json decodes original publisher settings.
published_default_camera.fov_axis: Horizontal when viewport width exceeds height; vertical otherwise. Square reference comparison uses vertical 75 degrees.

publisher_reference.method: Original publisher image downloaded unchanged and visually inspected.
publisher_reference.status: Published rendering of the captured architectural subject; this is not an independent ground-truth photograph.
publisher_reference.rights: Model licensing is explicit. A separate license grant for this publisher-generated poster was not located; retain as ignored research evidence and link to the source, without assuming permission for product asset reuse.
publisher_reference.camera_status: Poster camera is not embedded in image metadata or publisher viewer config. The default native viewer pose may differ. Do not compute or claim matched-camera pixel parity against this poster without a native viewer capture at the same pose.
publisher_reference.visible_features: Red-brick hall, gabled tiled roof, white bell tower, front door and steps, ramp railings, road edge, grass and trees; isolated capture boundaries and black background remain visible.

retained_incompatible_reference_pair.reason: Official repo sample has different count, bounds and codebooks from publisher source; original publisher camera cannot be assumed to apply. Only repo example is deliberately cropped/refracted glass-refraction, unsuitable as a neutral source-fidelity image reference.

native_runtime_replay.upstream_license: MIT, Copyright (c) 2011-2026 PlayCanvas Ltd.; retain copyright and permission notices with copies.
native_runtime_replay.rights_limit: MIT licenses establish upstream viewer and engine rights. Exact deployed bundle includes a host bootstrap wrapper and no bundled notice; a separate redistribution license for that wrapper has not been established. Keep deployed artifacts ignored and use for local research replay rather than product distribution.
native_runtime_replay.dependency_inspection: Acorn AST and es-module-lexer inspected the complete deployed script. No static module imports. Two dynamic runtime-variable shader compiler imports exist. CSS contains no external url() references.
native_runtime_replay.telemetry: Host wrapper sends first-frame and first-interaction beacons to relative /metrics; publisher HTML loads Sentry. Local independent replay should intercept these and deny nonlocal requests, recording the transport substitutions.

limitations: No native browser rendering, interaction, lifecycle or latency measurements were performed by this research subtask.
No Kyoto streets or six-sight route content is supplied.
No same-camera independent renderer comparison has yet been performed.
CC BY 4.0 source attribution is required in any redistributed derivative; commercial use does not remove attribution obligations.
Approximate acquired network input is 62.3 MB; local disk usage is larger because original components are duplicated inside the reproducible ZIP archive.
